questionText: What is @RequestBody and how does it work?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can trace JSON request-body conversion, distinguish Content-Type from Accept, add validation, and identify 400 versus 415 failures.

claims.statement: @RequestBody tells Spring MVC to read a request body into the declared method-parameter type through a compatible HttpMessageConverter.
Adding @Valid to an @RequestBody parameter applies Jakarta Validation after conversion, and ordinary MVC validation failures are resolved as HTTP 400 responses.
Malformed JSON and invalid converted fields normally produce 400 through different exceptions, while an unsupported Content-Type or consumes mismatch can produce 415.

examples.title: Verify valid, malformed, invalid, and unsupported request bodies

validation.command: Run gold.q3.RequestBodyTest with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.3.1, Bean Validation, and standalone MockMvc
validation.expected: Valid JSON returns 201; invalid fields and malformed JSON return 400; text/plain returns 415
